case.rationale: Exact near-side crosswalk branch; physical crosswalk tiles and governing West stop sign precede intersection entry.
unresolved_judgment_calls: Native sign governance and crosswalk pixels require original-frame review.
No invented stop epsilon or duration defines a legal full stop.
